title: Meet
tagline: Live streaming app for conferences, parties and other events conducted via video call or livestream
description: This project is designed to help users connect and interact via video conferencing and via the metaverse. Users will buy their tickets via the website and get nfts minted to their wallets. This project will further implement its own metaverse for virtual interaction. This project will make it easy to find interesting events in the virtual world and to participate to interesting parties in the metaverse(like Snoop Dog's party).
how_its_made: This project is deployed on polygon testnet and it integrates the sequence wallet to allow users to interact with the dapp. Further more, the livestreaming will be powered by livepeer. The idea is to have real parties and big events reproduced virtually with the same interaction as in a real event
